invariant: Java tries UML factories in order and the class factory accepts ordinary package blocks, quoted symbol-container commands through CommandPackageWithUSymbol, class declarations, and class relationships in one source. CommandCreateClass includes interface alongside class, enum, annotation, record, and the other class-family declaration keywords. A quoted node/frame/cloud container is therefore not a deployment discriminator when any explicit class-factory declaration makes the complete source valid for ClassDiagramFactory. Deployment-only containers remain deployment signals when no class-factory declaration establishes the earlier grammar.
causal_divergence: Rust now prevents late quoted-container promotion only for non-interface class declarations. Interface declarations receive a class score but do not set that guard, so valid interface-only sources with quoted node/cloud containers are promoted to DESCRIPTION even though Java's earlier ClassDiagramFactory accepts them. The non-interface controls pass, isolating the incomplete declaration-family predicate.
planned_change: Replace the non-interface-only guard with an explicit class-factory-declaration predicate set by every declaration accepted through Java CommandCreateClass, including interface. Use that predicate consistently for the quoted-deployment and component-container tie-breaks while preserving interface-plus-component-leaf behavior when there is no quoted class-container source.
